search_products.name: search_products
search_products.description: Search Zara catalogue using full-text search and faceted filters (department, category, price range, color, size, on sale). Returns compact product cards.

department.description: Department filter: WOMAN, MAN, or KIDS
department.title: Department

get_product_details.name: get_product_details
get_product_details.description: Fetch authoritative, full relational details for a Zara product by ID, including current price, variants, sizes, colors, swatches, images, and category hierarchy.

compare_products.name: compare_products
compare_products.description: Compare 2 to 4 Zara products side-by-side across key attributes including name, price, sale status, materials, available colors, and sizes.

product_ids.description: List of 2 to 4 product IDs to compare
product_ids.title: Product Ids

check_inventory.name: check_inventory
check_inventory.description: Check real-time stock levels across retail stores and online network by product ID, variant SKU, size, or color. Never hallucinates stock.

store_id.description: Filter for a specific store ID
store_id.title: Store Id

find_stores.name: find_stores
find_stores.description: Search synthetic demo Zara store locations by city, state, zip code, or geographical coordinates (ranked by distance in miles).

get_customer.name: get_customer
get_customer.description: Securely look up a customer profile by exact customer_id, email, or phone number. Blocks unconstrained enumeration.

get_order.name: get_order
get_order.description: Retrieve full details for an order by order number, including line items, payment status, shipment status, returns, and refunds.

customer_verification.description: Optional customer email or phone for verification
customer_verification.title: Customer Verification

track_order.name: track_order
track_order.description: Track carrier status and chronological tracking events for an order by order number.

check_cancellation_eligibility.name: check_cancellation_eligibility
check_cancellation_eligibility.description: Evaluate deterministic business rules to determine whether an order is eligible for cancellation before initiating any changes.

order_number.description: Order number to check for cancellation
order_number.title: Order Number

cancel_order.name: cancel_order
cancel_order.description: Cancel an eligible order with mandatory two-step confirmation protocol and idempotency. Releases reserved store inventory.

reason.default: Customer requested cancellation via AI assistant
reason.title: Reason

confirmation_token.description: HMAC confirmation token from prior check
confirmation_token.title: Confirmation Token

idempotency_key.description: Unique client key preventing duplicate cancellation
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

check_return_eligibility.name: check_return_eligibility
check_return_eligibility.description: Evaluate 30-day return window, remaining returnable item quantities, and calculate estimated refundable amounts for an order.

order_number.description: Zara order number to check for return eligibility
order_number.title: Order Number

create_return.name: create_return
create_return.description: Initiate a customer return for eligible items with mandatory two-step confirmation, quantity validation, and idempotency.

order_item_id.description: ID of line item to return
order_item_id.title: Order Item Id

reason_code.description: Reason code: DOES_NOT_FIT, DEFECTIVE, WRONG_ITEM, NOT_AS_DESCRIBED, CHANGED_MIND
reason_code.title: Reason Code

return_reason.default: Customer initiated return via AI assistant
return_reason.title: Return Reason

confirmation_token.description: HMAC confirmation token from prior check
confirmation_token.title: Confirmation Token

idempotency_key.description: Unique client key preventing duplicate return
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

get_refund_status.name: get_refund_status
get_refund_status.description: Inquire about processed refunds by order number, return ID, or refund ID.

check_exchange_availability.name: check_exchange_availability
check_exchange_availability.description: Check if an order item can be exchanged for an alternate size or color and verify stock availability for the replacement variant.

store_id.description: Optional store ID to check local availability
store_id.title: Store Id

find_similar_products.name: find_similar_products
find_similar_products.description: Find active products semantically similar to a catalogue product, with catalogue filters and synthetic inventory verification.

recommend_matching_products.name: recommend_matching_products
recommend_matching_products.description: Recommend active outfit candidates for a product using semantic similarity, a requested category, catalogue filters, and synthetic inventory verification.

get_size_guidance.name: get_size_guidance
get_size_guidance.description: Return documented product fit and size evidence without guaranteeing fit.

check_pickup_availability.name: check_pickup_availability
check_pickup_availability.description: Check synthetic demo store pickup availability for an exact product and store.

identify_customer.name: identify_customer
identify_customer.description: Identify a synthetic customer using an exact identifier and return masked verification guidance only.

verify_customer.name: verify_customer
verify_customer.description: Verify registered or guest synthetic customer access and issue a scoped expiring token.

get_customer_profile.name: get_customer_profile
get_customer_profile.description: Return a private customer profile only with transaction-verified access.

get_customer_orders.name: get_customer_orders
get_customer_orders.description: Return authorized customer order history or one guest-verified order.

get_loyalty_status.name: get_loyalty_status
get_loyalty_status.description: Return authenticated synthetic demo loyalty tier, points, and benefits.

check_promotion.name: check_promotion
check_promotion.description: Evaluate a synthetic demo promotion using deterministic backend rules.

check_exchange_inventory.name: check_exchange_inventory
check_exchange_inventory.description: Authenticated exchange eligibility and replacement inventory check; alias of the existing exchange availability capability.

create_exchange.name: create_exchange
create_exchange.description: Create an authenticated synthetic exchange with gateway confirmation and idempotency.

create_incident.name: create_incident
create_incident.description: Create a confirmed, authenticated synthetic order-item incident.

create_support_case.name: create_support_case
create_support_case.description: Create a confirmed, authenticated synthetic human-support case.

prepare_handoff.name: prepare_handoff
prepare_handoff.description: Prepare a least-privilege structured human handoff packet without transferring a call.

send_secure_link.name: send_secure_link
send_secure_link.description: Validate consent and destination, then return a delivery-not-configured secure-link contract.
